profile.headline: Christian | Lead Software Engineer | ex-DailyHarvest
profile.summary:
I am a Lead Software Engineer who has created applications using the .NET Core technologies as well as using Angular for the front-end and SQL Server/OracleDb as our database servers for the back-end.

I have created CI/CD pipelines using Azure Devops Server to help automate the development and deployment processes and am working on learning new technologies, such as Google Cloud and AWS, to help diversify my skill sets further.

I have created some applications for Android using IntelliJ/AndroidStudio as well as some iOS applications using Xcode and Swift. I am looking into learning Xamarin as well to see how phone app development works for both Android and iOS.

My goal is to create innovative solutions that are easy to use for our users so that they can do what they need to do faster instead of doing repetitive tasks that are time-consuming

positions.description:
Worked with the Vendor Equipment Finance team to create applications for our internal users to help create tools and web applications that let our Sales Representatives and Account Managers do their jobs more efficiently.

Full Stack Technologies:
* .NET Core 3.1, 2.1, 1.0
* .NET Framework 4.7.2, 4.5
* Angular 12
* HTML/CSS/TypeScript
* SQL Server
* OracleDb
* C#
* Azure Devops Server: Created pipelines and release pipelines for a CI/CD implementation
* Git - helped migrate the team from using TFVC to using Git
* Cloudbees - helped with the transition from Azure Devops Server to using Cloudbees for Jenkins
